1) SOC 2 scope: Our current SOC 2 Type II audit covers the hosted Redwood API (hosted in US and selected cloud regions). 3) HIPAA / BAA: We will sign a BAA for customers on Dedicated or Private; for hosted customers we have an offering that supports PHI but BAAs are handled case-by-case — Marissa will confirm the exact language.

Hi Ellie / Camila —

Thanks for the sheet, Ellie. I reviewed the flagged items and attached a short bundle with interim evidence (SOC2-in-progress-summary.pdf) and a redacted bridge letter (redacted-SOC2-bridge-letter.pdf). Answers below correspond to the rows you marked TBD in the SIG sheet.

1) SOC 2 scope: As Camila noted, the current Type II engagement covers our hosted API. For Dedicated/Private customers we provide architecture and control evidence on a per-deal basis; we can include those items in the SOW.

2) SOC 2 timeline/evidence: Audit fieldwork completed Feb 2027; final report expected Aug 2027. Interim evidence attached (control matrices, test evidence summary) and a bridge letter that describes coverage during the interim period.

3) Data residency: We operate in multiple cloud regions (US/EU/APAC). For EU-only processing we have region controls and contract language (DPA). We can restrict customer workloads to EU hosts for ZenHealth’s EU data.

4) BAA/HIPAA: We will sign a BAA. For hosted customers we require a short security review and configuration checklist; for Dedicated/Private we include BAA language in the contract. I’ve noted the standard BAA steps in the attached summary.

5) Encryption / key management: We by default encrypt in transit and at rest; customers can bring their own keys (KMS/HSM) for Dedicated and Private deployments — see attached summary.

Next steps:
- Ellie: please re-run the SIG Lite with the attached evidence references and mark any remaining open items.
- Camila: I’ll prepare a redacted SOC 2 package and the BAA template to share with ZenHealth legal.

Attachments: SOC2-in-progress-summary.pdf, redacted-SOC2-bridge-letter.pdf

Regards,
